text: Malaysia uses broad laws restricting free expression against its critics, and refugees and migrants there face indefinite detention.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: World Report 2026, Malaysia
source.quote: Despite some reforms, Malaysia continues to wield repressive laws to criminalize dissent, censor critical speech, and harass human rights defenders. Refugees and migrants face indefinite detention in overcrowded, unhygienic conditions.

additionalSources.name: Amnesty International: Malaysia 2025 (Amnesty International Report 2025/26)
additionalSources.quote: Broad laws limiting freedom of expression continued to be used against critics.
